entries.description: Free browser-local customizer for five templates: name keychain, articulated name, nameplate, plant label, and a personalized magnet with a blind rear disc-magnet pocket. No account is needed for one-off designs or individual exports. Exports are STL, one-model color-separated 3MF, and merged 3MF. Paid Maker adds reusable presets and batch tools; individual exports remain free. Names and geometry stay in the browser. Optional Google Fonts needs an API key and internet; built-in fonts work offline. The software is MIT-licensed; bundled fonts have separate SIL Open Font License terms.
representativeQueries: Customize a printable 3D keychain in the browser
Create a keychain design with Open Keychain
Make a personalized magnet with a disc-magnet pocket
